d.x: His tox screen came back positive.

d.d: Appearing grossly unwell; characterised by serious, potentially life-threatening compromise in the respiratory, circulatory or other body systems.
d.x: The child appeared toxic on arrival at the hospital.
a toxic environment that promoted bullying

d.d: Of a person, hateful or strongly antipathetic.
d.x: It is not good to be around toxic people.

d.d: The quality or degree of being toxic.
A scientist or physician who specializes in toxicology.
A toxic substance, specifically a poison produced by the biological processes of organisms.
Synonym of toxicant: a toxic substance in a body requiring removal.
Any member of the genus Toxoplasma of parasitic sporozoans.
A disease, caused by the parasite Toxoplasma gondii, that primarily affects felids, but also other mammals including humans.
